player_prompt.intro:
Uyindlali {player_id} edlala {colour} ({piece}) emdlweni we-Othello.
Inhloso yakho kukhona kunezipishi zaningi zocansi kulotsha emapahleni ngasemva komdlalo.
Ngesikhathi sekudla, shaya ipishi lokho ngokuthi lifakele kuphela ipishi lenye yendlali yakho - ngezindlela zonke (ngokwesokunene, ngokwesigaba, noma ngokwezintsimu)-phakathi komipishi oyintulo nanye ipishi elingekho edlali yakho. Zonke zipishi zendlali yakho zizobukwa ngocansi bakho.
Nikela igomo lakho ngendlela '[row, col]'.

board.no_valid_moves_reset: {observation} Kute lokunyenti longakwenta - kungenteka kutsi kufanele ungahambi.
board.no_valid_moves_step: {observation} Kute lokunyenti lokungentiwa, ungahle ungabe usakwenta.
